_comment: Undyed worsted wool suiting (Phase08 8.4, RD-P08-5): a fine, balanced 2/2 twill in combed wool, the cloth of a suit, a blazer or trousers. Authored at undyed wool's ecru so a Creator's tint (a 0-1 multiply) reaches the greys, navies, browns and charcoal below it: a suit is piece-dyed, so its colour is one constant. OPAQUE, semi-matte, with some FUZZ (worsted is smoother than felt, still wool). The twill (36 ends x 32 picks per cm) is the article's own normal and roughness.
name: WoolSuiting_Natural_Clean_Base_s001_v01

sources.why: Colour: undyed, scoured worsted wool, ecru (linear 0.64, 0.61, 0.54; no measured value), a touch darker than Felt_Natural's looser fibre. IOR 1.55: keratin. Roughness ~0.72 in the map: combed worsted has a faint lustre (felt ~0.92). Fuzz 0.35: smoother than felt (0.9), as denim-to-canvas among the cottons.
